CanBeGeneratedInCombat.maps_to: NOT PORTED -- the sim sets `can_be_generated_by_modifiers = False` instead (knowledge_curses.py:26)
CanBeGeneratedInCombat.issue: `public override bool CanBeGeneratedInCombat => false` has no counterpart: the sim's shared `_ChoosableCurse` base leaves `can_be_generated_in_combat` True and instead turns off `can_be_generated_by_modifiers` (knowledge_curses.py:26), which the C# card does not override (it stays `=> true`, CardModel.cs:648). Two mismatched flags in one card. Same mechanism and same verdict as card/disintegration's and card/mind_rot's entries (rule 3). DORMANT both ways: `pool_card_ids()` (IRONCLAD_POOL) holds no Status cards and the random-CURSE pool holds no Status-rarity cards.

ctor.issue: STATUS / STATUS / NONE map exactly. The canonical energy cost is -1 in C# and 0 in the sim. `CardEnergyCost.GetWithModifiers` returns early on `_base < 0` (CardEnergyCost.cs:100-103), so the game's unplayable card is immune to every cost modifier; the sim runs a base of 0 through the full modifier chain (cards/base.py:222-232). Only what is READ diverges. Same mechanism and same verdict as card/ascenders_bane's ctor entry (rule 3). DORMANT: every ported cost reader filters `> 0` or skips `<= 1`, and events/infested_automaton.py:35 filters pool_card_ids(), which holds no curses, statuses or quests.

CanonicalVars.rationale: `new PowerVar<SlothPower>(3m)` (Sloth.cs:18) == `default_power_amount = 3`, copied into `self.power_amount` by `_init_vars` so it is re-seeded on downgrade. Note the amount is a CARD-PLAY LIMIT (3 cards per turn), not a damage or stack count.

OnChosen.maps_to: _ChoosableCurse's power application via CombatState.select_cards (knowledge_curses.py module docstring; the chooser is the Knowledge Demon)
OnChosen.rationale: `PowerCmd.Apply<SlothPower>(new ThrowingPlayerChoiceContext(), Owner.Creature, DynamicVars["SlothPower"].IntValue, Owner.Creature, this)` (Sloth.cs:25-28) == the sim's select-then-apply path reading `power_cls` and `power_amount` off the chosen card. Self-target, self-applier, amount 3. `KnowledgeDemon.IChoosable` is an interface rather than a CardModel override, so the harness's `public override` scan does not enumerate it -- added by hand. NOTE: SlothPower's 3-cards-per-turn limit is the same MECHANIC as card/normality's, and normality's port reads the wrong history (plays finished vs plays started); whether SlothPower repeats that mistake is the power stream's to check.

guards.what: the sim marks the card `is_playable = False` (knowledge_curses.py:23); Sloth.cs declares NO Unplayable keyword
guards.issue: C# gives this Status no CanonicalKeywords at all, so in the game it is a PLAYABLE no-effect Status. Same mechanism and same verdict as card/disintegration's and card/mind_rot's guards (rule 3). DORMANT: the four Knowledge-Demon cards never reach a combat pile on either side.
